title: P3 request_action: result
description: Result of request_action: the approval number and state, or a refusal with a code. The attempt ends after the request; the initiator gets the request number and a copy of the card.

items.description: Group capability: a string of the form <form>:<name> from capabilities.yaml, without an asterisk, for example task:ops.investigate.v1, service.control:nginx, admin:people.
